# runzero_groups (Data Source)

Fetches a list of RunZero groups.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Attributes List) List of groups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the group was created.
- `created_by_email` (String) Email of the user who created the group.
- `description` (String) Description of the group.
- `expires_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the group expires.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the group.
- `name` (String) The name of the group.
- `org_default_role` (String) The default organization role for the group.
- `role_summary` (String) Summary of roles assigned to the group.
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the group was last updated.
- `user_count` (Number) Number of users in the group.
